closes_when: The central body outline and lower edge rise and fall by a few pixels in a gradual cycle across frames, and the mouth dash moves gradually rather than switching position at frame 4.
protect: Exact doodle construction from c.png (pointed head-body blob, two small loop eyes, dash mouth, left lobe with forked foot, right lobe with scalloped base), the stable placement left of center matching the film, the sparse grey scenery lines, and the absence of doubling or redraw flicker.
